st: The Official D&D Actual Play Series - Arcana Unleashed - Ep.5: Belly of the Beast
d: True to form, the party splits up once more, chasing down the people, and the perils, that matter most. A rescue against the clock. A pursuit of something far too massive to reason with. Somehow, against every possible odd, it might just be enough.

st: High Rollers: A Rogue's Gambit #7 | The Eye Catcher
d: The team continue their adventure in the ISTAR facility and head towards the Eye Catcher!
Sujata and Chef Mike are joined by Jared Logan to make Fire-Spiced Abyssal Chicken Kebabs.
Rinn and Robbie set out to seek a cure.
The party is reunited and gain some magical amphibians.
